title: Baptism and Eucharist — Tradition Overview (Edition 1)
description: Baptism initiates believers through water, and the Eucharist shares bread and wine recalling the Last Supper. Most traditions count these two as sacraments instituted by Christ. This overview edition presents Baptism and Eucharist within the world's religious landscape, factually and without favor.

spec.overview: Baptism initiates believers through water, and the Eucharist shares bread and wine recalling the Last Supper. Most traditions count these two as sacraments instituted by Christ.
sacred_texts: Gospel accounts of baptism and the Last Supper
practices: Infant or believer baptism by branch
spec.adherents: Practiced across Catholic, Orthodox, and Protestant churches.

example.fact: Eastern Orthodox baptism is by full immersion, typically of infants.

spec.study_note: Core facts verified from public sources; adherent figures are estimates from the Pew Research Center.
